title: My First Day at School
content: Today is my first day at middle school. I am very happy but a little nervous. My new teacher, Ms. Wang, is kind and friendly. She tells us about our class rules. Then I meet a girl named Li Mei. She sits next to me. We talk about our favorite subjects. I like English and she likes math. After class, we play games together on the playground. I think I will enjoy my school life here.

questions.q: What is the main idea of this passage?
options: B. The writer's first day at middle school
C. How to play games on the playground
D. A new teacher named Ms. Wang
questions.explain: 主旨大意题。全文讲述了作者第一天上学的经历，包括见到新老师、认识新朋友等，因此选B。

questions.q: Who sits next to the writer?
questions.explain: 细节理解题。根据文中Then I meet a girl named Li Mei. She sits next to me.可知，李梅坐在作者旁边，选C。

questions.q: What does the underlined word "nervous" probably mean in Chinese?
questions.explain: 词义猜测题。根据上下文，第一天上学应该是既高兴又有点紧张，nervous意为紧张的，选A。
